_doc: Style cards: what stays true for every film in one style, mapped onto this engine. `studio.py craft styles apply <id>` writes look/motion/transitions into film/style.json and palette/backdrop into gfx beats that have none. See references/styles.md.

styles.essence: Night-blue ground that slowly breathes, one warm accent reserved for the number that matters, charts that draw themselves.
moves: A number lands: counter in the accent with glow, everything else muted
Colour flood on the turn: the ground changes, the hero number stays
A line chart draws left to right and the last point glows
pitfalls: Two glowing elements in one frame
Chart with no unit or source on screen
Amber used for decoration instead of meaning

styles.essence: Paper ground, ink type, one terracotta mark. Feels printed, not generated: big headline, small caption, generous margins.
moves: Marker sweep under the one phrase that carries the claim
Headline sets in still, then the caption arrives under it
Map contours drift behind a date
pitfalls: Centred everything; use the RTL column

styles.essence: Violet depth on a perspective grid, glass cards stacked in z, a pink counterpoint used once.
moves: Glass cards enter staggered at three depths and parallax
Iris opens from the element just named
A flow of cards joined by drawn connectors

styles.essence: Deep green, gold for money only, slow keynote light sweeps. Trustworthy, never flashy.
moves: Bars grow left to right over time, the last one in gold
Progress fills right to left toward a goal
A coin-gold badge pops on the result
pitfalls: Fast whips in a calm money story

styles.essence: Cold deep ground with drifting particles, one sun-coloured accent for scale reveals.
moves: Scale reveal: a small ring grows until it fills the frame
Particles slow down before the big number
Donut segments draw one by one for proportions

styles.essence: Plum dusk, coral accent, soft dot-matrix wave: human and warm, never clinical.
moves: A presenter points at one card
Ring fills to a percentage that the VO says
Blur swap between two states on one stage
pitfalls: Red alarm colours for normal facts

styles.essence: Black, white and one red. Hard cuts on the beat, giant type, nothing decorative.
moves: Type carries the argument: one word per beat at 60-90% of the width
Dip cut: frame darkens for three frames before the hard cut
The red only on the word that is wrong
pitfalls: Red on more than one element
Flash transitions on every seam (photosensitive viewers)

styles.essence: Off-white ground, cobalt for the action, orange for the result. The real UI is the hero; graphics only frame it.
moves: Zoom through the button that was just clicked
The result card carried across into the next screen
Lower third names the screen, then leaves
pitfalls: Mock UI presented as the real app

styles.essence: Warm night market: amber lantern light sweeping a dark ground, products as glass cards.
moves: Light beam sweeps across the product card as it lands
Badge pops on the offer, once
Cards rise in a staggered shelf
pitfalls: Price on screen in the CTA
Fixture products in a client film

styles.essence: Words are the picture. Whole Arabic words enter, hold dead still, leave; never letters.
moves: Word-by-word blur-in, no translate
One word in the accent rolls through options
Hero word fills the width, quiet line at a third of its size
pitfalls: Titles that keep drifting after they land

styles.essence: Graded warm cinema: slow camera, long holds, one hero object filling a third of the frame.
moves: Slow push-in on the one detail that matters
Hold before the payoff, then the payoff lands on the beat
Object becomes the world: a card grows past the frame
pitfalls: Fast cuts that fight the grade

styles.essence: Daylight paper, one action per step, the cursor and callout do the talking.
moves: Camera zooms onto the next click, the cursor arrives on time
Spotlight box dims everything else
Step badge counts 1 / 4
pitfalls: Re-drawn UI instead of the capture
